scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @cartogo/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,website -c blue,green "npm:dev --workspace @cartogo/api" "npm:dev --workspace @cartogo/website"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cartogo/contracts && npm run build --workspace @cartogo/api && npm run build --workspace @cartogo/website
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @cartogo/contracts && npm run test --workspace @cartogo/api
